title: Weather Summary
description: Write `summary(text)` where `text` is JSON from a weather API: `{"name": "Delhi", "main": {"temp": 301.15}}` (temperature in **Kelvin**). Return `'Delhi: 28.0 C'` (Celsius, rounded to 1 decimal). If the JSON has no `main` key, return `'No data'`.
starter_code:
import json

def summary(text):
    # Write your code here
    pass
solution_code:
import json

def summary(text):
    data = json.loads(text)
    if 'main' not in data:
        return 'No data'
    celsius = round(data['main']['temp'] - 273.15, 1)
    return f"{data['name']}: {celsius} C"
